messages.text:
"Create a 2D card pack-opening and collection game themed around insects. Players start with a menu to open booster packs containing random insect cards (ranging from common ants and beetles to rare glowing fireflies, tarantula hawks, and legendary prehistoric mega-insects). Each card displays the insect's name, rarity tier, stats (attack, defense, speed), and a short scientific trivia fact. Include a collection gallery screen where players can view all unlocked cards, track their completion percentage, and inspect card details.
"
